FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 214
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Senator Chris Elliott
Economic Development
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 03/17/2025
Senate Bill 214 as introduced could decrease the obligations of the Department of Corrections
by an undetermined amount dependent on any decrease in license plate production due to the
provisions of this bill.
